watch.summary: A streamer dramatically shouts as he times a jump off a flying drone while playing as an egg.

beats.what: Creator explains his plan to figure out how to jump off the drone.
The drone flies into the building through a tight gap.
Creator yells 'ALLOW ME OUT!' and jumps off.
The egg lands smoothly and safely on a wooden beam.
Creator praises himself and laughs at the smooth maneuver.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The comedy stems from the streamer's intense, frantic vocal delivery over a silly egg video game. His desperate yell of 'ALLOW ME OUT!' creates a funny contrast with the surprisingly smooth landing.
